resolved_conflicts.explanation: The A-Z list says the 1939 tower was the relocated first Remer tower; the Cass County entry says the first Remer tower was likely moved to the site when the second Remer was built in 1938. The story treats the move as probable.

notes_for_editor: No removal date for the 1939 tower in any source; FFLA gives status only. Height 24.7 m is 81 feet converted (the A-Z and Cass lists give feet). No build date for the first tower. The 1934-1947 survey note is quoted from the A-Z list's own notes. The A-Z list's 'relocated' wording is firmer than the Cass County entry's 'likely'. The Blueberry Hill site is not in the kjackson.us 2010 working-tower PDF (weak evidence, not used). Two guessed kjackson.us per-tower pages returned 404. The central-us page for Blueberry Hill carries only survey coordinates and township data.
